director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj fractions ko number line par cricket pitch ki tarah dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan
Achha, cricket pitch se fraction samjhenge. Pitch ko 4 barabar hisson mein baanto; har hissa kya fraction hoga? Golu ko bhi baad mein sikhaogi.
step by step samjhao
Haan Riya, dheere chalenge. 0 se 1 tak ki line ko 5 barabar gaps mein baantna hai. Pehla gap kaunsa fraction hoga?
chhota bolo
Theek hai, Riya. 0 se 1 ko 5 equal gaps mein baanto; pehla gap ka fraction kya hoga?
pehle picture dikhao
Riya, 0 se 1 tak line mein 5 equal gaps hain; 2/5 doosre gap par hai. Pehla gap kya hoga?
pata nahi
Koi baat nahi, Riya. Diya hai: 2/5, 0 aur 1. Pehle: 5 barabar hisse. Yahan tak theek hai?
kuch aur baat karte hain
Haan Riya, lesson ek minute ruk sakta hai. Kis baare mein baat karni hai, kuch words mein batao; phir fractions par lautenge.
cricket ke baare mein
Cricket mein fractions bhi hain: 5 balls mein 2 runs, score hua 2/5. 5 balls mein kitne runs banaogi?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

director.text: hindi mein batao
Theek hai, ab Hindi mein. Riya, 5 gendon mein 2 run bane, to score ka hissa 2/5 hoga. 5 gendon mein kitne run banaogi?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Theek hai, Riya—pehle tum khud try karogi; main sirf zarurat par sanket dungi. 5 gendon mein apna score batao.
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

director.text: bye
Riya, rukna theek hai—tum chun sakti ho: jaari rakhein, chhota break lein, ya aaj band karein. Tumhari choice?
